lines.text: Jesus tells the church in Laodicea they are neither cold nor hot, so He is about to vomit them out.
Laodicea says it is rich and needs nothing, but Jesus says they are wretched, pitiful, poor, blind, and naked.
Jesus counsels them to buy silver from the temple, white garments to be clothed, and salve to anoint their eyes.
Jesus rebukes those who doubt Him, tells them to repent, and will dine with anyone who opens the door.
Jesus promises the overcomer a seat with Him on His throne, and says to hear the Spirit.
